title: Grateful Dead Live at Bellarmine College on 1968-12-07

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with decent clarity (despite hiss and cuts) highlights a rare Rosemary performance, a smoking Dark Star and an intense Other One suite.
ai_review.review: The show is celebrated for its historic rarity – the only known live Rosemary – and strong improvisations on Dark Star, New Potato (Caboose) and the Other One suite. While the soundboard source is generally good for a 1968 recording, reviewers note noticeable hiss and several edit cuts that affect continuity. Overall the musical moments outweigh the technical flaws, making it a valued gem of the late‑'68 era.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (4–5 stars) praise the performance and rarity of songs, while acknowledging recording hiss and cuts; weighted combination of strong show quality (~4.2) and decent but imperfect recording (~3.5) yields an overall ~4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear for a '68 tape, but noticeable hiss throughout and multiple partial cuts/editing glitches (especially early set). Morning Dew > Bid You Goodnight segment is highlighted as especially clean.

standout_songs: That's It For the Other One suite
poor_songs: Morning Dew (criticized by some as weak)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set considered solid but not extraordinary; second set ramps up with an intense Other One suite and strong jams, though occasional sloppiness is noted. Overall flow moves from mellow opening to a fiery middle‑to‑late segment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for blazing guitar work, intergalactic Dark Star tones, risky volume‑knob experiments and stellar solos throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for a “nasty” bass jam in New Potato and powerful thunder on The Other One suite; some reviewers highlight his classical‑like turn.
